name: Arisaka Offset Optic Mount
teaser: A MUCH cleaner offset sight mount. Another one of my autistic thoughts that I unfortunately made a reality.
description_html:
THIS IS BUILT ON GROOVEYPENGUIN FROM W.T.T.’S CODE! ALL CODING CREDIT GOES TO HIM AND THE WTT TEAM!

Due to this being based on his code, if he wants to removed I’ll do so.

This is the Arisaka offset sight mount. It is a 35-45 degree angle optic mount that I liked and thought looked a whole lot cleaner than the current NcSTAR MPR45 offset mount. This will fit anywhere that will.

The whole thing is split into 5 pieces, 1 base mount and 4 optic mounts. All can be bought for cheap from Delta lvl1.

MASSIVE THANKS TO EVO FOR HELPING WITH THE TEXTURES

***DELTA TRADER IS REQUIRED TO BE ABLE TO BUY FROM TRADERS***

INSTRUCTIONS:

You get the base mount, then get a plate, then throw the compatible optic on top of it.

Plate Mounts + Optics listed below

Acro Plate- Can equip the ACRO P-1 optic

Docter Plate- Can equip the Burris Fastfire III optic

Micro Plate- Can equip the Aimpoint T1 + H2 as well as the SIG Romeo4 optic

ShieldRMS Plate- Can equip the Leupold DeltaPoint optic
